title: Beneficiary Designation and Trust Account Rules at US Financial Institutions

files.beneficiary_rules.csv / .json: Beneficiary designation rules, one row per institution and account group.
files.trust_accounts.csv / .json: Rules for an account owned by or retitled to a trust, one row per institution and account group.

account_groups.ira: Traditional, Roth, SEP, SIMPLE and inherited IRAs
account_groups.bank_pod: Bank and credit union payable on death (POD) accounts

row_columns.segment: brokerage, bank, credit_union, recordkeeper, insurer, pension or hsa
row_columns.account_types: Account types covered (semicolon separated in the CSV)
row_columns.florida: yes if the institution is headquartered in Florida or is a Florida state plan

per_field_columns.value: yes, no or not stated. A yes or no always carries a verbatim quote from the institution's own document. "Not stated" means the public documents read are silent. It does not mean the option is refused.
per_field_columns.detail: A short note on what the document says, written by the compiler.
per_field_columns.quote: The institution's own words, verbatim (whitespace, quotation marks and hyphenation normalized; "..." marks omitted text).
per_field_columns.account_type: The account type or form the value was read from, where the institution has more than one in the group.
per_field_columns.page: Page of the document the quote is on, or "web page".
per_field_columns.source_url: The institution's own URL for the document. Where the live URL refused scripted requests, the quote was read from an Internet Archive (Wayback Machine) capture of that URL.
per_field_columns.form_number: The form number printed on the document, if any.
per_field_columns.revision_date: The revision or edition date printed on the document, if any.
per_field_columns.wayback_capture: Date of the Wayback Machine capture the quote was read from, if not read live.

beneficiary_fields.trust_primary: Can a trust be named as primary beneficiary?
beneficiary_fields.trust_contingent: Can a trust be named as contingent beneficiary?
beneficiary_fields.trust_details_required: Does the form require trust details (name, date, trustee, TIN)?
beneficiary_fields.trust_naming_required: To name a trust, must the form give the trust date and trustee name, or use 'as trustee' wording?
beneficiary_fields.trust_docs_requested: Does the institution ask for trust documents (and when)?
beneficiary_fields.see_through_certification: Does it ask the owner or trustee to certify see-through status or supply the Treas. Reg. 1.401(a)(9)-4 documentation?
beneficiary_fields.subtrust_naming_format: Does it give a format for naming sub-trusts or separate shares?
beneficiary_fields.per_stirpes_definition: Does the institution define per stirpes?
beneficiary_fields.per_capita_offered: Is per capita (or per capita at each generation) offered as a distribution option?
beneficiary_fields.ldps_or_descendants_allowed: Can the owner name a class such as 'lineal descendants, per stirpes' (LDPS), 'my descendants' or 'my children' without listing each person?
beneficiary_fields.banned_language: Does the form ban specific words, phrases or references?
beneficiary_fields.custom_designation_accepted: Does it accept a custom or attorney-drafted designation?
beneficiary_fields.custom_review_process: Does it describe how a custom designation is reviewed?
beneficiary_fields.minors: Can a minor be named (and with what arrangement)?
beneficiary_fields.estate_allowed: Can the owner's estate be named?
beneficiary_fields.default_beneficiary: Does it state who takes if no designation or no beneficiary survives?
beneficiary_fields.successor_beneficiary: Can a beneficiary name a successor beneficiary?
beneficiary_fields.lapse_rule: Does it state what happens to a predeceased beneficiary's share?
beneficiary_fields.spousal_consent: Is spousal consent required in some circumstance?
beneficiary_fields.spousal_consent_mechanics: Are consent mechanics stated (notary or plan representative, time limit, wet signature)?
beneficiary_fields.divorce_revocation_stated: Does the document say whether divorce revokes a designation of the former spouse?
beneficiary_fields.max_beneficiaries: Is a maximum number of beneficiaries stated (yes = a limit; no = stated to be unlimited)?
beneficiary_fields.online_designation: Can the designation be made online (no = paper only)?
beneficiary_fields.notarization_or_medallion: Must the owner's signature be notarized or medallion guaranteed?
beneficiary_fields.esign_accepted: Is an electronic or digital signature accepted for the designation (no = wet signature required)?
beneficiary_fields.submission_method: Is the way to submit the designation stated (detail lists online, mail, fax, upload, in person)?
beneficiary_fields.stated_processing_time: Is a processing time stated for the designation or change?
beneficiary_fields.disclaimer_procedure: Does it describe how a beneficiary disclaims (qualified disclaimer)?

trust_account_fields.trust_account_offered: Can an account be opened or retitled in a trust's name?
trust_account_fields.certification_accepted: Is a certification of trust (or the institution's own trust certification form) accepted?
trust_account_fields.full_instrument_required: Is the full trust instrument required?
trust_account_fields.pages_required: Does it specify which pages or excerpts of the trust must be provided?
trust_account_fields.trustee_id: Is identification required for each trustee?
trust_account_fields.tax_id: Does it state whether the grantor's SSN or a trust EIN is used?
trust_account_fields.successor_trustee_proof: Does it state what a successor trustee must provide?
trust_account_fields.grantor_death: Does it state what is required when the grantor dies?
trust_account_fields.trustee_change: Does it state what is required when a trustee changes (resigns, is added, is removed)?

csv_naming: In the CSV each field appears as <field> (the value) followed by <field>_detail, <field>_quote, <field>_account_type, <field>_page, <field>_source_url, <field>_form_number, <field>_revision_date, <field>_wayback_capture and <field>_retrieved.
